title: do-thing config
description: Sibling schema for do-thing.config.jsonc. Gives editors validation + autocomplete, and _jsonc.py fails fast on a bad value. See 04-config-files-jsonc.md.

DEFAULT_INPUT.description: the tool's usual input folder (double-click menu option 2); $HOME expands

CONFIG_INPUT.description: a fixed input path (double-click menu option 3); $HOME expands

PROMPT.description: optional: text the engine generates from, if your tool takes one

SEED.description: variation control; same seed => identical output

NAME.description: output name (default: derived from the input)

GUIDANCE.description: prompt adherence; higher = closer, less natural
